original.question: When I was 2 years old, my brother was half my age. Now I am 60 years old, how old is my brother?

thoughts.current:
Solution: When you were 2 years old, your brother was half your age, which means he was 2 / 2 = 1 year old. So, your brother is 2 - 1 = 1 year younger than you. Now that you are 60 years old, your brother would be 60 - 1 = 59 years old.

Answer: A) 59
